'''Ron Robinson''' (born 1965) is an American cosmetic chemist and researcher who is the founder of the [[skin care|skincare]] brand BeautyStat and the formulator of the teen skincare label Yes Day.<ref name="auto3">{{Cite web|url=https://www.essence.com/beauty/beautystat-founder-ron-robinson-chemistry-of-success/|title=The Chemistry Of Success: How BeautyStat Founder Ron Robinson Went From Pre-Med Dropout To Beauty Industry Pioneer|date=November 15, 2024 |first=Kimberly |last=Wilson |website=[[Essence (magazine)|Essence]]}}</ref><ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://www.vogue.com/article/how-black-beauty-brand-founders-honor-juneteenth|title=9 Black Beauty Founders on How They're Honoring Juneteenth |first=Kiana |last=Murden|date=June 17, 2022|website=[[Vogue (magazine)|Vogue]]}}</ref> He also helped launch [[Hailey Bieber]]'s skincare line, Rhode, which was later acquired by [[e.l.f.|e.l.f. Beauty]] for $1 billion.<ref name="auto4">{{Cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/11/02/fashion/ron-robinson-skin-care-beautystat.html|title=Experts Say He Knows the Science of Skin Care|first=Rachel|last=Felder|date=November 2, 2025|via=New York Times}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Robinson was born in [[Brooklyn, New York]] in 1965 to parents who emigrated to [[New York City]] from the [[Caribbean]].<ref name="auto4"/> He earned a [[Bachelor of Science|B.S.]] in [[chemistry]] and [[biology]] from [[Adelphi University]] in 1987.<ref name="adelphi">{{Cite web|url=https://www.adelphi.edu/news/ron-robinson-87-2/|title=Ron Robinson ’87 &#124; Adelphi Alumnus|date=May 5, 2016 |first=Todd |last=Wilson}}</ref> He later attended the [[University of Medicine and Dentistry of New Jersey]] medical school (now part of [[Rutgers Biomedical and Health Sciences|Rutgers Health]]) before leaving after one year.<ref name="allure">{{Cite web|url=https://www.allure.com/story/ron-robinson|title=Product Finder Expert of the Week: Ron Robinson |date=December 1, 2011 |first=Colleen |last=Egan|website=[[Allure (magazine)|Allure]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.essence.com/beauty/black-beauty-chemist-behind-rhode-skincare/|title=Meet The Black Beauty Chemist Behind A Billion Dollar Skincare Revolution|date=July 29, 2025 |first=Danielle |last=James |website=Essence}}</ref>

==Career==
===1990–2008: Early career===
After leaving medical school, Robinson joined [[Clinique]] ([[The Estée Lauder Companies|Estée Lauder]]) in 1990 as a cosmetic chemist and later promoted to senior chemist and then product development manager.<ref name="auto3"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.blackenterprise.com/meet-ron-robinson-the-genius-behind-stabilized-vitamin-c/|title=Here’s How Chemist Ron Robinson Is Paving The Way For Innovative Skincare In A Booming Industry|first=Sharelle B.|last=McNair|date=June 3, 2025}}</ref> He led the development of several [[anti-aging cream|anti-aging moisturizers]] that became best-sellers. He spent about a decade at Estée Lauder, including work with [[Aramis (fragrance)|Aramis]] and [[Crème de la Mer|La Mer]], then held senior product development roles at [[L'Oréal]] [[Lancôme]] division, [[Revlon]], and [[Avon Products|Avon]] through 2008.<ref name="auto3"/><ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.uschamber.com/co/good-company/the-leap/beautystat-beauty-chemist|title=A Beauty Chemist's Secrets to Building a Blockbuster Brand|first=Faye|last=Brookman|date=March 18, 2025}}</ref>

===2009–present: BeautyStat, Rhode, and Yes Day===
In 2009, Robinson founded BeautyStat as a [[blog]] focused on evaluating beauty products from a chemist's perspective.<ref name="auto3"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/08/fashion/this-is-your-skin-on-stress.html|title=This Is Your Skin on Stress|first=Jessica|last=DeFino|date=December 8, 2020|via=NYTimes.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chicagotribune.com/la-ig-expensive-creams-20121111-story.html|title=A pretty penny for prettier skin?|website=Chicago Tribune}}</ref> In 2013, BeautyStat expanded its operations and launched an [[e-commerce]] store.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://wwd.com/business-news/retail/beautystat-relaunches-with-e-commerce-7247498/|title=Beautystat Relaunches With E-commerce|first=Belisa|last=Silva|date=October 24, 2013}}</ref> Later, Robinson also held resident expert roles at ''[[Allure (magazine)|Allure]]'' and ''[[Refinery29]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.allure.com/story/ron-robinson|title=Product Finder Expert of the Week: Ron Robinson|first=Colleen|last=Egan|date=December 1, 2011|website=Allure}}</ref> In 2016, he joined Influence Nation as managing director.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://wwd.com/business-news/human-resources/feature/ron-robinson-influence-nation-10556603/|title=Ron Robinson Signs on at Influence Nation|first=Rachel|last=Brown|date=September 21, 2016}}</ref>

After receiving repeated questions about [[vitamin C]] instability, Robinson developed a method to stabilize pure [[ascorbic acid|L-ascorbic acid]].<ref name="auto3"/> He funded the research himself, spent five years on development, and obtained three [[patent]]s.<ref name="auto3"/><ref name="auto1"/> In 2019, he launched BeautyStat Cosmetics with the Universal C Skin Refiner, a serum containing 20% stabilized vitamin C.<ref name="auto2">{{Cite web|url=https://wwd.com/beauty-industry-news/beauty-features/beautystat-gen-x-moisturizer-peptides-ulta-1236137408/|title=BeautyStat Launches New, Gen X Moisturizer|first=James|last=Manso|date=January 19, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://wwd.com/beauty-industry-news/skin-care/feature/new-patented-encapsulated-vitamin-c-launches-with-beautystat-1203079676/|title=New Patented, Encapsulated Vitamin C Launches With BeautyStat|first=Allison|last=Collins|date=March 7, 2019}}</ref>

In 2021, Hailey Bieber contacted Robinson after using BeautyStat's vitamin C serum and asked him to help develop her skincare line.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.glossy.co/beauty/ron-robinson-beauty-stat-glossy-50/|title=Ron Robinson, Beauty Stat &#124; Glossy 50 2022|first=Sara|last=Spruch-Feiner|date=November 9, 2022}}</ref> He worked on formulations for over a year before Rhode launched in June 2022.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://wwd.com/beauty-industry-news/beauty-features/rhode-hailey-biebers-minimalist-beauty-brand-1235205964/|title=Meet Rhode, Hailey Bieber's Minimalist Beauty Brand|first1=James|last1=Manso|date=June 15, 2022}}</ref> He serves as cosmetic chemist-in-residence and sits on its skincare advisory board.<ref name="auto4"/> Rhode was acquired by e.l.f. Beauty in May 2025 for about $1 billion.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wsj.com/style/fashion/hailey-bieber-rhode-what-next-c9b2e911|title=How Hailey Bieber Made Rhode Into a $1 Billion Success Story|first=Chavie|last=Lieber|date=October 14, 2025|website=The Wall Street Journal}}</ref>

In 2022, BeautyStat expanded to [[Ulta Beauty]] stores across the [[United States]] and raised a [[Series A round|Series A]] round led by VMG Partners and True Beauty Ventures.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://wwd.com/beauty-industry-news/beauty-features/beautystat-ulta-beauty-1235055629/|title=BeautyStat Teams Up With Ulta Beauty|first=James|last=Manso|date=January 28, 2022}}</ref> Notable BeautyStat products include the Universal C Skin Refiner [[Sunscreen|SPF]] 50<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://wwd.com/beauty-industry-news/beauty-features/beautystat-launches-vitamin-c-spf-1235562597/|title=BeautyStat Ventures Into Sunscreen|first=James|last=Manso|date=March 3, 2023}}</ref>, a [[peptide]] moisturizer<ref name="auto2"/>, a [[coconut milk]] serum, and a vitamin C [[lip gloss|lip serum]] with mineral SPF 30.<ref name="auto4"/>

In October 2025, Robinson worked as formulator with Coco Granderson to launch Yes Day, a skincare brand for teens and tweens.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.glossy.co/beauty/exclusive-rhodes-formulator-joins-13-year-old-founder-on-yes-day-a-new-gen-alpha-skin-care-brand/|title=Pop Newsletter Exclusive: Rhode's formulator joins 13-year-old founder on Yes Day, a new Gen Alpha skin-care brand|first=Sara|last=Spruch-Feiner|date=September 19, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.blackenterprise.com/13-year-old-skincare-line-yes-day/|title=13-Year-Old Launches Youth-Focused Skincare Line With Famed Black Chemist Behind 'Rhode'|first=Nahlah|last=Abdur-Rahman|date=October 27, 2025}}</ref>

As of 2026, Robinson also serves on the advisory board of Adelphi University.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.adelphi.edu/news/accidental-cosmetic-chemist-alums-formula-for-success-combines-skin-care-celebrity-events-and-student-mentorship/|title="Accidental Cosmetic Chemist" Alum's Formula for Success Combines Skin Care, Celebrity Events and Student Mentorship|date=August 6, 2024 |first=Liza N. |last=Burby}}</ref>
